verdict.rationale: Exa offers a dedicated Answer endpoint, priced at $5/1k requests and described as "An LLM answer to a question, with citations." The official SDK exposes it as a single call, `exa.answer(...)`, under "Get answers with citations." Deep Search and Exa Agent runs also return grounded, cited answers. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the Answer endpoint's citation format and parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
